The Opportunity

The AI Engineering & Enablement team at Euna is accelerating AI adoption across the company, and this co-op role works alongside the Director, AI-Enablement & Automation at the center of that effort. You will support the enterprise-wide rollout of AI tools, help build out our N8N automation platform, and show non-technical teams how to put AI to work. If you want real-world experience building automations with exceptional visibility and mentorship, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do



- Support the enterprise rollout of AI tools, including user onboarding, training, and adoption initiatives across business units.
- Design, develop, and maintain N8N workflow automations, with guidance from senior team members, to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency.
- Contribute to building and deploying MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that connect internal applications to our central company knowledge base.
- Partner with cross-functional teams to identify automation opportunities and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
- Deliver AI enablement training and create learning materials that help employees adopt AI tools and build their own automations.
- Assist with administration and ongoing development of the N8N platform, aligning your work with the AI Engineering team's strategy and infrastructure.
- Document automation patterns and best practices, and report on AI impact, including time savings, efficiency gains, and adoption.

What You Bring



- You are currently in the 4th year of a university program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, and eligible for a co-op work term.
- You have proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) through coursework, personal projects, or prior co-op terms.
- You have familiarity with APIs, integrations, or RESTful services.
- You communicate clearly and can explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
- You bring curiosity, learn quickly, and work comfortably with stakeholders across both technical and business teams.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications



- Exposure to workflow automation platforms (N8N, Zapier, Power Automate, or similar)
- Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI application development, including personal or academic projects
- Exposure to MCP server development or similar integration frameworks
- Experience presenting, tutoring, or leading workshops

Location

This position will be hybrid with 3 days/week in our Oakville, ON office.



- This is an 8 month coop placement starting early January 2027.

Compensation Range: $25 - $35/hr

We believe in openness, so we publish our range from the start. Where an offer will land depends on your background, strengths, and how you'll contribute to the work ahead.

This role fills an existing vacancy. Euna uses AI responsibly to assist in screening, assessing, or selecting applicants. AI helps us work smarter, but people lead the process.

AI Mindset at Euna Solutions

We believe the future of work is human + AI. At Euna Solutions, we encourage our team members to leverage AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and decision-making. We're looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment, not replace, their expertise.

If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you'll thrive here.

Life at Euna Solutions

We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and public sector champions. We've built a workplace around a straightforward idea: people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and not running on empty.

Here's What That Actually Looks Like

🏢 How we work

We're hybrid — three days a week in our Oakville or Atlanta offices, with standard hours on those days. What the remaining days look like depends on your role and your manager. We talk about it early in the process so there are no surprises on either side.

🧘 Eunafier Days

Twice a year, you get an extra day tacked onto a long weekend. We think recharging is part of doing good work — not a reward for it. Use it however you need.

🙌 Community is part of who we are

Our Engagement Committee finds meaningful ways to give back through time, donations, and shared expertise. We're invested in the places where our people actually live and work.

🤝 Philanthropy Time

We give every employee up to eight hours a year to spend on causes that matter to them. We want you to show up for your community — and we make time for it.

🎉 Real connection at scale

You won't know all 600+ people — and that's okay. What matters is building real relationships with the people you work with every day. Our culture team creates consistent opportunities for that, so work doesn't feel isolating.

📈 Room to grow

Whether you're going deep on AI, building expertise in government tech, or stepping into a bigger role, we invest in your development — through budget, mentorship, and real opportunity to move when you're ready.

About Euna Solutions

Euna Solutions® is the leading provider of purpose-built, cloud-based software designed to streamline procurement, budgeting, payments, and grants management for public sector and government organizations. Euna's AI-powered features and intelligent automation help organizations make better-informed decisions, ensure compliance, empower collaboration, and reduce administrative burden. Euna's full-cycle financial suite supports more than 3,600 organizations across North America in building trust, enabling transparency, and driving positive community impact. Recognized on Government Technology's GovTech 100 list, Euna Solutions is committed to advancing public sector innovation. To learn more, visit www.eunasolutions.com. Euna's privacy policy is available here.

Please visit our website: https://eunasolutions.com/careers/ and check out our LinkedIn Pages https://www.linkedin.com/company/eunasolutions/

We believe in embracing new perspectives and optimizing impact. If you have relatable experience and relevant transferable skills but feel you may be missing a few of the requirements, we encourage you to apply! We recognize that people have unique career journeys and if you're excited about this role and know you can bring something great to the team, then we want to hear from you. Please know Euna Solutions is committed to providing a comfortable and accessible interview process for every candidate. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process (big or small), please let us know.

For any inquiries or requests regarding accessibility at Euna Solutions, please email recruiting@eunasolutions.com or call our office at 1.877.707.7755. Upon request, appropriate accessible formats or arrangements will be provided as soon as practicable.

We’re on the hunt for a Engineering Student – AI/ML Specialist in our AI Analytics Team at our Richmond, BC office. This is an 8-months role, starting January 2027. 

As a member of the Engineering team you will support our geospatial services with the state-of-the-art in artificial intelligence and machine learning to push the boundaries of a wide range of geospatial applications. You will work as part of a world-leading team to develop new capabilities and deliver cutting edge solutions to our customers.

Overall the successful candidate would be treated similar to a new graduate joining our company, where tasks will be assigned relative to the level of schooling and experience achieved to date.

Responsibilities

As an Engineering Co-op – AI/ML Specialist you may have a wide range of responsibilities that may include:



- Performing technical engineering tasks, such as operational analyses and trade-off studies, to define system design and subsystem details 
- Contribute to the development of machine learning algorithms to help interpret remote sensing data
- Participate in the research and validation of machine learning architectures for earth observation
- Build ML-ready datasets from satellite imagery, including from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) missions
- Contribute to the benchmarking and validation of machine learning algorithms
- Participate in the development of agentic AI applications leveraging internal tools and platforms

You will support intermediate and senior engineers in the above tasks and have opportunities for professional growth.

Requirements



- Have familiarity with: 
- Python or other programming languages (i.e. C++, Matlab) for scientific and geospatial tooling
- MS Word and MS Powerpoint, for the purpose of generating reports and presentations
- Experience in scripting and/or programming
- Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and/or Generative AI
- Have excellent verbal and written communication skills 
- Be a self-starter with the ability to perform in a dynamic working environment 
- Possess excellent problem solving skills 
- Have a team-friendly attitude and willingness to learn 

While not mandatory, candidates will benefit from any of the following:



- Familiarity with satellite remote sensing or earth observation
- Familiarity with signal/image processing techniques
- Familiarity with LLMs and agentic workflows
- Familiarity with modern software development methodologies and MLOps

Experience

Interested candidates should be working towards a Bachelor’s degree or post-graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Geography/GIS or other relevant disciplines. Students must be currently enrolled in their studies to be considered.  If enrolled in a post-graduate program, the co-op is required to be part of the program.

Comments/Special Considerations

Successful candidates must obtain and hold security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Controlled Goods Program (CGP).

MDA Ltd. is proud to provide accommodation(s) during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodations, please indicate this on your application/cover letter and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

 Software Engineering builds the brains of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software allows the Waymo Driver to perceive the world around it, make the right decision for every situation, and deliver people safely to their destinations. We think deeply and solve complex technical challenges in areas like robotics, perception, decision-making and deep learning, while collaborating with hardware and systems engineers. If you’re a software engineer or researcher who’s curious and passionate about Level 4 autonomous driving, we'd like to meet you. 

 Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

 You will: 

• Design and Prototype Auto-Research Loops: Architect and implement end-to-end autonomous research workflows using Google Antigravity to enable LLM-powered agents to generate, run, and evaluate their own post-training experiments. 

• Develop Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) Workflows: Build and refine agentic feedback mechanisms that allow reinforcement learning (RL) models to iteratively learn from their own simulation rollouts and continuously self-correct. 

• Analyze & Triage Agentic Execution: Set up rigorous evaluation and root-cause analysis pipelines to monitor, debug, and improve the decision-making quality of the autonomous research agents. 

• Publish & Document Findings: Collaborate with senior researchers to document novel methodology, benchmark performance gains, and prepare high-quality submissions for top-tier academic conferences. 

 You have: 

• Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science or a closely related field. 

• Demonstrated Research Expertise: Proven track record of independent research in machine learning, reinforcement learning (RL), agentic AI, or human-machine interaction, ideally supported by publications in top-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CHI, CVPR). 

• Hands-on Agentic & RSI Development: Deep technical experience developing autonomous agentic workflows, recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops, or large language model (LLM) orchestration frameworks. 

 We prefer: 

• Publications in machine learning, AI, reinforcement learning, ML systems, human computer interaction conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, CHI, AAAI). 

• Hands on experience designing and building self-play architectures, auto research loop or recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops where models autonomously generate, evaluate, and learn from their own code, prompts, or data. 

• Practical experiences in advanced reinforcement learning techniques (such as offline RL, RLHF/RLAIF, or curriculum learning) applied directly to complex, high dimensional closed loop simulation environments. 

 Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.
 
 The expected hourly rate for this full-time position is listed below. Interns are also eligible to participate in the Company’s generous benefits programs, subject to eligibility requirements.

 Hourly PhD Pay

 $85—$85 USD

jd:
ABOUT GEORGIAN



Georgian is a Toronto-based venture capital firm that partners with high-growth technology companies across cybersecurity, AI software, robotics, defense. We manage about $6B in assets and we have invested in more than 80 companies that we support with capital and technical capability.



Our in-house AI lab works directly with portfolio companies to provide a differentiated experience across the investment lifecycle, and drives the adoption of AI for our internal operations.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

 

As an intern in Georgian’s AI Lab, you’ll work on the brain of the robot: the models it thinks with, the data it learns from, the simulators it practices in and the systems that get all of that onto real machines. You’ll work alongside our scientists and engineers on research, portfolio projects and technical diligence, and you’ll own a scoped project of your own. This is a software role. You won’t design hardware, but you’ll learn enough about the body to understand what it will and won’t let the brain do.



 


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

 

Physical AI is a core investment thesis area for us. Our portfolio includes Bedrock Robotics, Path Robotics, Vention, and other frontier robotics companies. We think most of what separates these companies is the brain, not the body: how they collect and use data, the models that see and act, the world models and simulators they train against and the tools that get a new behavior from the lab onto a fleet of machines. That’s the part of the stack you’ll work on as an intern. You’ll help the AI Lab follow the latest in robot learning, run experiments and build tools, and support our work with portfolio companies and on technical diligence. You’ll know how a learned policy behaves on a real robot and what a working sim-to-real pipeline looks like. And you’ll be able to tell a system that’s really deployed from a good demo.



 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN & DELIVER

 

 - Support robot learning research. Help the team keep up with what’s new in VLAs, world models, sim-to-real and evaluation. Reproduce results from recent papers, run experiments and ablation studies, and contribute to internal tech notes and write-ups.

 - Hands-on R&D. Train and evaluate policies in simulation under guidance, using imitation learning or reinforcement learning. Assist in building data pipelines, evaluation setups and small tools that make experiments faster and easier to repeat.

 - Contribute to portfolio projects. Support AI Lab team members working with portfolio companies on robot-learning software. Assist with code implementation, testing and documentation, and help track results the companies care about, like task success rate and how often a person has to step in.

 - Support technical diligence. Help the investment team assess physical AI companies by researching the technical landscape and preparing technical question lists. Document what we find, including whether a company’s autonomy is learned or scripted and how it holds up beyond the demo.

 - Own a scoped project. Take one focused project from idea to result, such as a sim-to-real benchmark, a policy training pipeline or an evaluation of a new model, and present it to the AI Lab and the wider Georgian team.

 - Communicate technical work. Turn what you learn into clear documentation, demos and short presentations for audiences with different technical backgrounds.

 
 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 


IDEAL ATTRIBUTES

 - Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master’s or PhD in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering or a related field, with a focus on machine learning, reinforcement learning or robotics.

 - Hands-on experience training deep learning models in a modern framework (PyTorch, JAX or similar), with strong Python and clean, reproducible code.

 - Working knowledge of robot learning: imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and the basics of VLAs, world models and sim-to-real transfer.

 - Some exposure to robotics systems through coursework, research, a lab or a competition team, even if you haven’t deployed outside a lab

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and with asking good questions when you’re stuck; a clear writer and speaker




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with simulators (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, ManiSkill or similar) or LeRobot

 - Time on real robot hardware, including research, hobby or competition projects

 - Basic C++ and ROS 2, enough to read an on-robot stack

 - Classical robotics background: motion planning, state estimation or control

 - Published work or open-source contributions in robot learning (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, LeRobot or similar)

 - Interest in industries like manufacturing, industrial automation or construction




CULTURAL ATTRIBUTES WE LOVE

 

 - Ambition and agency: You want to do big things and don’t wait to be told; you’re at your best with little structure and a lot of ownership

 - Curiosity: You chase problems to the root cause and keep asking “why,” even when the answer turns out to be a loose cable rather than the model

 - Team over ego: You make the people around you better, colleagues and founders alike

 - Plain talk: You can explain a hard technical thing briefly enough that a busy CEO gets it the first time

 - Builder: You’d rather ship a rough policy to a test cell today than a perfect one next quarter, and you know the difference between a demo and a deployment

 
 


HIRING PROCESS

 

We don't hire like a MAG7 or scale up — in fact we rarely hire compared to them.

 

You shouldn't expect a cookie-cutter high-volume hiring process with us — but a more boutique one that allows you to see a lot of the organization before joining us.

 

We build a thesis in what an individual brings to our very small team, versus simply matching qualifications:

 1. 30‑min intro (values & motivations)

 2. 60‑min technical interview (ML fundamentals & problem‑solving)

 3. Project discussion with team members



 


POSITION STATUS

 

This posting represents an active, future internship vacancy on our team. We are currently interviewing for this role.




OUR COMMITMENT TO ACCESSIBILITY



Georgian is dedicated to building an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We provide reasonable accommodations throughout our recruitment process to ensure every candidate has the opportunity to perform at their best.
